Strom, in principie) vvriteth, that ſuch admit no mariage nor procreation of children, leſt they ſhould bring into the vvorld creatures to ſuffer miſerie and mortalitie. And this is the damnable opinion concerning mariage, noted here by the Apoſtle.

And vvine they called the gall of the Prince of darkenes, and not to be drunke at al, and the Vine vvhereof it came, to be of the Diuels creation.
